# Central background updates settings toggle (2026-04-27 00:29Z)

_**User**_

Requested a new prominent central on/off switch at the top of iPhone Settings when frequent background location updates are active, distinct from the advanced settings. The description should explain that Advanced Options are available and that the mode can be centrally disabled here. The switch should only be visible while the non-significant-change background mode is active.

The user then requested that battery usage information be included in the new setting, and finally asked to document the change in the changelog and commit it.

---

_**Agent**_

Added a top-level iPhone Settings section that appears only when location tracking and frequent background location updates are both enabled. The new central toggle is bound to the same `frequentBackgroundLocationUpdatesEnabled` setting as Advanced Options, so disabling it immediately returns Miataru to the standard significant-change background mode.

Added localized explanatory text for the central toggle across all supported app languages, including a note that further configuration remains available in Advanced Options. Reused the existing localized battery warning under the new setting so the increased battery impact is visible without opening Advanced Options.

Updated `SettingsConfigurationTests` so the new localization key is covered by the localization parity test, and updated `CHANGELOG.md` for version 3.1.7.

Verified the string catalog and settings coverage with:

```sh
jq empty miataru/miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings
xcodebuild test -project miataru/miataru.xcodeproj -scheme miataru -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,id=290112D5-BE60-4109-9CEF-2B99369BA054' -only-testing:miataruTests/SettingsConfigurationTests
```
